content: Registration and DI without a plugin loader: a typed Map-backed registry keyed by string id, where register returns a disposer, duplicate ids throw loudly, and each descriptor carries an apiVersion plus capability flags. Contract validation belongs at registration time, not per record. React Context is the composition root and the component tree is the dependency graph. DI containers (tsyringe, inversify, awilix, typed-inject, brandi, iti) are unnecessary; hookable 6.1.2 and tapable 2.3.3 are generic hook buses, not typed registries, so they are deferred until plugin lifecycle exists. JupyterLab and VS Code token patterns are the cheapest credible design if a loader ever lands.
